## 👋 About Me

I'm a full-stack developer who loves turning ideas into real products. I'm most at home in the backend: API design, microservices, and wiring AI into systems that actually ship.

- 🔨 **Currently building** [Reign & Gain](https://getsweatygames.com/reignandgain), a mobile fitness RPG where verified real-world workouts power your progression
- 🤖 **Lately exploring** LLM agents and voice AI with Claude, LangGraph and the OpenAI Realtime API
- ☁️ **Also shipping** infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions on AWS
- 🎓 **B.Sc. Computer Science**, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev
- 📫 **Reach me** at [yarinso39@gmail.com](mailto:yarinso39@gmail.com) or on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/yarin-solomon/)

      <h3>🎮 Reign &amp; Gain</h3>
      A mobile fitness RPG where real workouts drive roguelite progression. The client is untrusted: a Fastify server re-scores raw Health Connect signals before awarding anything, and combat runs on a seeded, fully reproducible engine.

      <br /><br />
      <code>Python</code> <code>FastAPI</code> <code>Claude API</code> <code>OpenAI Realtime</code> <code>WebRTC</code> <code>Twilio</code>

      <br /><br />
      <code>Python</code> <code>LangGraph</code> <code>Claude API</code> <code>ChromaDB</code> <code>SQLite</code> <code>FastAPI</code>

      <br /><br />
      <code>React</code> <code>TypeScript</code> <code>FastAPI</code> <code>Whisper</code> <code>Claude API</code> <code>Docker</code>
